# Justice Equity Services Index (JESI) Results

```{r}

#purples
pal_impact <- colorBin(palette = c("#54278f","#605DA2", "#9391BF", "#CBC9E2","#F2F0F7" ), domain = jesi$jesi_pctl, bins = 5, reverse = TRUE, pretty = FALSE)


#create popup
popup <- paste("<div class='hasjesi'><div class='leaflet-data' data-zip='", jesi$zipcode,
               "' data-neighborhood='",jesi$lat_neighborhood,
               "' data-jesi-pctl='",jesi$jesi_pctl,
               "' data-jesi-category='",jesi$jesi_category,
               "' data-jesi-rank='",jesi$jesi_rank,
               "' data-population='",prettyNum(jesi$population_count, big.mark = ",", preserve.width = "none"),
               "' data-sd-number='",jesi$sd_number,
               "' data-sd-name='",jesi$sd_name,
               "' data-spa-number='",jesi$spa_number,
               "' data-spa-name='",jesi$spa_name,
               "' data-health-category='",jesi$c1_health_well_category,
               "' data-house-category='",jesi$c2_housing_emp_category,
               "' data-preven-category='",jesi$c3_preven_inter_category,
               "' data-fam-category='",jesi$c4_fam_comm_category,
               "' data-health-pctl='",jesi$c1_health_well_pctl,
               "' data-house-pctl='",jesi$c2_housing_emp_pctl,
               "' data-preven-pctl='",jesi$c3_preven_inter_pctl,
               "' data-fam-pctl='",jesi$c4_fam_comm_pctl,
               "' data-total-health-services='",jesi$c1_health_well_raw_count,
               "' data-physical-health-services='",jesi$phys_health_raw_count,
               "' data-behavioral-health-services='",jesi$behav_health_raw_count,
               "'></div></div>")


# create custom legend labels
labels <- c(
"Lowest (0-19th Percentile)",
"Low (20-39th Percentile)",
"Moderate (40-59th Percentile)",
"High (60-79th Percentile)",
"Highest (80-100th Percentile)")

# build map
leaflet(jesi, width = "100%", height = "600px", options = leafletOptions(zoomControl = FALSE)) %>%

# add base map
# new code: add base map
    addTiles(
      urlTemplate = paste0("https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/light_nolabels/{z}/{x}/{y}.png?key=", carto_key),
      attribution = '&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a>, &copy; <a href="https://carto.com/attributions">CARTO</a>'
    ) %>%
    addTiles(
      urlTemplate = paste0("https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/light_only_labels/{z}/{x}/{y}.png?key=", carto_key),
      # attribution = '&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a>, &copy; <a href="https://carto.com/attributions">CARTO</a>',
      options = providerTileOptions(pane = "markerPane") # retain unique setting 
    ) %>%
# add map panes
addMapPane("index_pane", zIndex = 400) %>%
addMapPane("missing_pane", zIndex = 410) %>% 
  addMapPane("jeni", zIndex = 415) %>%
addMapPane("sds_pane", zIndex = 420) %>%
addMapPane("spas_pane", zIndex = 420) %>%


# set view and layer control
  setView(-118.6368454, 34.2324274, zoom = 8.5) %>%
addLayersControl(overlayGroups = c("Supervisorial Districts","Service Planning Areas", "JENI - High/Highest Need ZIP Codes"), options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE, autoZIndex = TRUE)) %>%
  
# create sidebar and add html for content
addControl(html='<div class="leaflet-popup-scrolled"><div class="zipcode-header"  style="margin-bottom: 8px; margin-top: 8px;"><span class="square-icon"></span><span class="zip" style="font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold;"></span></div><span style="font-size: 12px; font-weight:bold; line-height: 1.5em;">JESI Percentile*:<span class="jesi-pctl" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span> |
<span class="jesi-category color-format-jesi" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight:bold;"></span><br/><div class="progress-bar"><div class="progress-jesi"></div></div><br/>Component Percentiles*</span><br/><span style="font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5em;">Health & Wellness:<span class="health-pctl" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span><br/><div class="progress-bar"><div class="progress-health"></div></div><br/>Housing & Employment:<span class="house-pctl" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span><br/><div class="progress-bar"><div class="progress-house"></div></div><br/>Prevention & Intervention:<span class="preven-pctl" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span><br/><div class="progress-bar"><div class="progress-preven"></div></div><br/>Community Sevices & Advocacy:<span class="fam-pctl" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span><br/><div class="progress-bar"><div class="progress-fam"></div></div><br/><br/><span style="line-height: 1.5em; display: block; width: 95%;"><span class="zip-details" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span> has a <span class="jesi-category-details color-format-jesi"></span> overall service level. It also scores <span class="health-category color-format-health"></span> on Health & Wellness,
<span class="house-category color-format-house"></span>
on Housing & Employment, <span class="preven-category color-format-preven"></span> on Prevention & Intervention, and  <span class="fam-category color-format-fam"></span> on Community Services & Advocacy.<br/><br/>Neighborhood: <span class="neighborhood" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span><br/>JESI Rank: <span class="jesi-rank" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span> out of 277 ZIP Codes<br/>Population: <span class="population" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span><br/>Supervisorial District: <span class="sd-number" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span> | <span class="sd-name" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span><br/>Service Planning Area: <span class="spa-number" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span> | <span class="spa-name" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span></span><br/><br/><span style="font-size: 10px; font-style: italic;">*Percentiles range from 0-100. A higher percentile means a higher level of services in that area.</span></span></div>', position = "topleft") %>%
  
# add polygons for JESI ZIP Codes
addPolygons(color = "black", 
            weight = 1, 
            smoothFactor = 0.5, 
            opacity = 1.0,
            fillOpacity = .8, 
            fillColor = ~pal_impact(jesi_pctl), 
            highlight = highlightOptions(color = "white", 
                                         weight = 5, 
                                         bringToFront = TRUE, 
                                         sendToBack = TRUE), 
popup = ~popup,
group = "JESI", options = pathOptions(pane = "index_pane")) %>%

# add polygons for ZIP Codes wit no JESI
  addPolygons(data=nojesi,
              color="#444444", 
              weight = 1, 
              smoothFactor = 0.5, 
              fillOpacity = .8, 
              fillColor ="#808080", 
              highlight = highlightOptions(color = "#444444", 
                                           weight = 3, 
                                           bringToFront = TRUE, 
                                           sendToBack = TRUE),
              popup = ~paste0("ZIP Code:<b> ", nojesi$zipcode, "</b></br>",
                              "No JESI Available</br>Population:<b> ", 
                              nojesi$population_count, "</b></br>"),
              options = pathOptions(pane = "missing_pane"))%>%  
  
# add boundaries for SPAs and SDs
addPolygons(data = sds, 
            opacity = 1.0,
            dashArray = "10 5",
            fillOpacity=0, 
            color = "black", 
            weight = 2.5, 
            label=~distname, 
            group = "Supervisorial Districts", 
            options = pathOptions(pane = "sds_pane", 
                                  interactive = FALSE), 
            highlight = highlightOptions(color = "white", 
                                         weight = 3, 
                                         bringToFront = TRUE)) %>%
  addPolygons(data = spas,
              opacity = 1.0,
              dashArray="5 5",
              fillOpacity=0, 
              color = "black", 
              weight = 2.5, 
              label=~spa_2012, 
              group = "Service Planning Areas", 
              options = pathOptions(pane = "spas_pane", 
                                    interactive = FALSE), 
              highlight = highlightOptions(color = "white", 
                                           weight = 3, 
                                           bringToFront = TRUE)) %>%  

# add boundaries for highest need JENI Zips
addPolygons(data = jeni_highest, 
            opacity = 1.0,
            fillOpacity=0, 
            color = "black", 
            weight = 2.5, 
            label=~zipcode, 
            group = "JENI - High/Highest Need ZIP Codes", 
            options = pathOptions(pane = "jeni", 
                                  interactive = FALSE), 
            highlight = highlightOptions(color = "white", 
                                         weight = 3, 
                                         bringToFront = TRUE)) %>% 

    #add combined legend  
   addLegend(position = "bottomleft",
            title="JESI Service Level",
            labels = c("Lowest (0-19th Percentile)", "Low (20-39th Percentile)",
                       "Moderate (40-59th Percentile)", "High (60-79th Percentile)","Highest (80-100th Percentile)", "JESI Not Available"),
            colors= c( "#f2f0f7","#cbc9e2","#9391BF", "#605DA2", "#54278f", "#808080"), opacity=1.0)%>%

  
  # layers control
  addLayersControl(
    overlayGroups =  c("JENI - High/Highest Need ZIP Codes",
      "Supervisorial Districts",
      "Service Planning Areas"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = TRUE),position = "topright")  %>%
 hideGroup("Supervisorial Districts") %>%
  hideGroup("Service Planning Areas")%>%
    hideGroup("JENI - High/Highest Need ZIP Codes")%>%
 htmlwidgets::onRender("
        function() {
            $('.leaflet-control-layers-overlays').prepend('<label style=\"text-align:left\">Click to view</label>');
            L.control.zoom({ position: 'topright' }).addTo(this);
        }
    ")
```

```{js}
// This function is used to color code degrees of JESI index ratings in popup feature
// Elements include: square icon, main index progress bar, and "lowest" to "highest" keywords


<!-- Captures  -->
var mapsPlaceholder = [];
L.Map.addInitHook(function () {
  mapsPlaceholder.push(this);
  mapsPlaceholder.forEach(map => {
```
